title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final expression for the force of magnetic attraction.

title: Use of Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies relevant equations for magnetic fields and forces in the context of the problem.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student demonstrates proper integration techniques to calculate the total force over the specified geometry.

title: Vector Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly derives or utilizes the vector potential in their calculations.

title: Sign and Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes errors in signs or units throughout the calculations.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student provides a clear physical interpretation of the results, including the nature of the force (attractive or repulsive).

title: Symmetry Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student recognizes and applies symmetry arguments to simplify the problem.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student explores or mentions alternative methods to arrive at the same result.
